CanteenState.title: CanteenState
CanteenState.description: Represents the live state of the canteen including menu items, today's lunch tiffin, queue telemetry, and announcements.

menuItems.description: List of food items offered at the canteen.

todayLunch.description: Details of today's lunch thali (roti, sabzi1, sabzi2, dal, rice, price, availability).

estimatedWaitTime.description: Estimated waiting time at billing counter.

nextBreak.description: Time until the next lecture break.

nextBreakLabel.description: Name or period label of the next break.

announcements.description: List of active notices displayed on the canteen notice board.

todaysSpecial.description: Featured special dish of the day.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Designates an authenticated user as an authorized Canteen Administrator.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin role was granted.

/canteen_state/{stateId}.description: Live shared state of the canteen, readable by students and staff, writable by verified canteen admins.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Registry of authorized admin user UIDs.
